company.shortDescription: Stabble is the first frictionless exchange protocol on Solana that eliminates financial losses for all DeFi users.
company.description: Stabble is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform built on the Solana that provides a decentralized exchange (DEX) and liquidity infrastructure for crypto trading. It is designed to enable efficient token swaps and liquidity provision with higher capital efficiency and lower trading costs compared to traditional automated market maker (AMM) systems.
